method: Positive two-stage amplitude decays fitted to four Hann-squared weighted power windows, weak rate priors; absolute recorded velocity levels retained.
limits: One edited Yamaha upright corpus with ordinal velocity proxies and unknown mic geometry. Held-out features excluded. Modal reduction is distinct from the preserved mechanical solver. Upper partials beyond measured bands use negligible authored floors.

confidence_priors.reason: Pitch/inharmonicity unidentifiable; missing partials use same-note training shape, not analysis fallback values.
